facts.fact: Johanna Randrianasolo said the RAHAKA data-exchange platform, run by the Digital Governance Unit (UGD), had logged over 162,000 exchanges among fourteen institutions by end April 2026.
RAHAKA connected fourteen institutions by end April 2026, per Johanna Randrianasolo of the Conseil d'Etat.
